title: Universal Semantic Enhancement for Weakly Supervised Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.23765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weakly supervised anomaly detection on tabular data is an essential task in many label-scarce applications, since tabular data is widely encountered and it is commonly observed in practice that only a limited number of labeled anomalies are available alongside abundant unlabeled samples. Most existing methods try to learn features that capture the inherent distribution patterns in the target domain. However, such features often struggle to provide a complete description of possible abnormal characteristics and are highly susceptible to overfitting the extremely scarce labels. To address this challenge, we propose a weakly supervised anomaly detection method based on universal semantic enhancement for tabular data, which fuses the universal knowledge from a pre-trained tabular foundation model with the domain-specific knowledge learned on the target dataset. tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于通用语义增强的表格数据弱监督异常检测方法，通过将预训练表格基础模型的通用知识与目标数据集的领域特定知识相融合，有效解决了现有方法特征描述不完整且易过拟合稀缺标签的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a weakly supervised anomaly detection method for tabular data based on universal semantic enhancement, which fuses universal knowledge from a pre-trained tabular foundation model with domain-specific knowledge from the target dataset to address incomplete feature descriptions and overfitting to scarce labels.
